name: Merentha
english_description: A classic English-language LPMud lib explicitly based on the popular Nightmare 3 lib, per its own description aiming to have "the Nightmare feel and robustness without the complications of verbs or weird lfun names." New characters wake in a race-selection limbo room (a wall of frozen male/female bodies in wall compartments, one pair per race), pick a gender and race with `become <gender> <race>` from six options (human, giant, gnome, elf, dwarf, fairy), and land in the Cabeiri starting town with its central square, guild halls (fighter/mage/healer/monk), and general supply shop. Ships a full skill-point system (30+ skills from swordplay to alchemy to bargaining), a limb-based body model, an Intermud-3 daemon, and a wizard-oriented `/cmds/admin` toolset. Porting it surfaced one real driver-compat blocker: this driver's PACKAGE_UIDS support requires get_root_uid()/get_bb_uid() master-object applies that this archive never defined at all (the driver refuses to boot past master-object load without them) -- fixed by porting the same two-line pair used by the closely-related nightmare3 lib in this collection. Everything else in the ~140-file mudlib compiled and ran clean on the first pass.
